text_block_list.text:
After spending some time out with Symboli Rudolf,
we returned to the academy.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it is nothing. It was just surprisingly
wonderful recreation for me today, even by my own standards.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
How about you?
Were you able to relax and let your wings spread?
choice_data_list: I'm glad to see Rudolf having fun
It was the absolute best day!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Good grief, I heard about you, you know.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
However—I would like to thank you once again
for always taking my best interests into consideration.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...I have tried spending my time in various ways until now to prepare both my mind and body.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "There were quite a few effective ways to pass the time among them, but..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No time could ever surpass today.

It seemed she had a wonderful day off,
which made me feel happy as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, well! That's quite an ambitious claim!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Well, that—
I might be the same.
